lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of vertical columns containing between 4 to 6 high-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed in a grid formation posterior to the gill region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with faint horizontal pathways; circular spots are positioned as anchor nodes at these intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A linear feature extends horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance boundary with high intensity on the dorsal side and a shadow gradient below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct reddish-brown circular feature is visible superior to the first gill slit, contrasting with the surrounding grey and white pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense, stochastic distribution of small high-luminance clusters, differing in scale and organization from the larger, grid-aligned spots on the flank.
